messages:
alexg: Heads up — customer reported reconnect after an early EOF and they got charged for the truncated stream + the resumed stream. reproducer attached.
mira.k: Ugh. Did they reconnect to the same backend or get routed to a fallback? any logs?
sam: Logs show client got EOF, retried with same session_id but different resume_offset. Router routed to a different host on reconnect.
jon: That matters — our billing dedupe now keys on backend session instance id, not the client session_id, so different host -> double charge.
pranav: Short-term: we can dedupe at the ledger layer by (customer_id, client_session_id, prefix_hash) for N secs. Long-term: need a clear contract for session identity across handoffs.
alexg: Repro logs:
```
INFO stream: client_id=acct-123 session_id=sess-9f2 EOF at offset=2048
INFO router: handoff sess-9f2 -> host-gpu-12 reason=evict
INFO client: reconnect session_id=sess-9f2 resume_offset=2048 -> routed host-gpu-23
```
This is the scenario.
mira.k: Two issues: 1) routing can change identity for accounting, 2) console/telemetry surfaces confirmed vs provisional charge poorly.
sam: For (1) we could add a canonical session header `x-rw-session-id` that follows client session across handoffs. Router must preserve it in ledger events.
jon: Or ledger should accept an optional client_session_id field and use that for dedupe precedence when present. That keeps router simpler.
pranav: For (2) console currently shows final charged tokens only. We should display provisional tokens in the realtime trace view (yellow highlight) and then flip to confirmed after ack window.
alexg: Agree on UI change. Also need telemetry events: `stream.tokens.emitted`, `stream.charges.provisional`, `stream.charges.confirmed`, and `stream.handoff.count` with tags for routing path.
observability-bot: New metric suggestion received: stream.tokens.emitted (counter), stream.charges.provisional (counter), stream.charges.confirmed (counter), stream.handoff.count (counter). Recorded as feature request #4129.
billing-bot: Note: provisional credits are reversible. If we keep provisional rows in ledger we must ensure reconciliation process can atomically flip/adjust without double applying.
sam: Implementation proposal:
- Router: attach `client_session_id` to all handoff events (no change to routing logic).
- Ledger: when receiving charge event, if `client_session_id` present, compute dedupe key = (customer, client_session_id, prefix_hash) and check recent window 30s.
- Console: show provisional entries tagged `status: provisional` and aged 0-60s before confirmation.
- Reconciliation job: flip provisional -> confirmed on final ack, or refund if truncated.
jon: One open debate: should dedupe window be time-based or seq-based (offset)? If client might replay older offsets, time window is safer but could hide legitimate retries if delay > window.
pranav: Maybe hybrid: dedupe by (client_session_id, resume_offset) primarily; if resume_offset missing fallback to time-window. That handles exact resumes without relying on clocks.
alexg: Good idea. Also add a small sampling trace to log full routing path for disputed charges (customer opt-in) so support can debug quickly.
mira.k: I'll sketch PRs: one for router header propagation, one for ledger dedupe, one for console UX, and telemetry/metrics. I'll link them here when ready.
alexg: Thanks. Created a short internal RFC doc: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/78 with the proposed dedupe contract.
pranav: One more: docs+SDK should mention that clients should set `client_session_id` on reconnects to avoid double charge. Add to quickstart.
jon: Agree. Also add tests that simulate host handoff + reconnect to catch regression.
mira.k: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/321, https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/210, https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/142
sam: Reviewed router PR, left comments about header normalization and size limits.
alexg: Support pinged for customer case to explain we're working the fix and will reconcile provisional charges.
mira.k: Will follow up with a timeline. :thumbsup:
